$comment: The three committed font binaries (design language v3), with the upstream they came from and a
sha256 for each. `fonts.test.ts` reads this file in both directions: a recorded digest that does
not match the file, and a file in `assets/fonts/` with no row here.
A hash answers "did the file change", not "is the file safe". The upstream repository and the
commit are recorded so replacing a file means editing a row somebody reads.
Inter and JetBrains Mono replaced Geist and Geist Mono in v3. Inter carries an optical-size axis
(opsz 14-32), so text and titles each get the cut drawn for their size; the subset keeps it.
